title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mazi Smith works out for Packers
items.desc: The Packers hosted Mazi Smith for a workout on Monday.
items.impact: Smith was recently released by the Dolphins.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Micah Parsons (knee) not practicing this week
items.desc: Micah Parsons will not practice this week.
items.impact: Parsons will not return in Week 7. The Packers are not ruling out a Week 8 return for him.

items.impact: Neal will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.desc: The Patriots released D'Shawn Jamison from their practice squad.

items.desc: The Patriots signed Andrew Rupcich to their practice squad.
items.impact: Rupcich will add depth for New England.

items.impact: Rizy will add depth for New England.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ryan Miller signs with Patriots
items.desc: The Patriots signed Ryan Miller.
items.impact: Miller was waived by Miami. He will add depth with New England.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Elliott Davison signs to Patriots active roster
items.desc: The Patriots signed Elliott Davison to their 53-man roster.
items.impact: Davison will add depth in the safety room for New England.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Malik Turner elevated by 49ers
items.desc: The 49ers elevated WR Malik Turner for Monday's game against the Commanders.
items.impact: Turner will add depth in the wide receiver room for San Francisco.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalen Graham elevated by 49ers
items.desc: The 49ers elevated LB Jalen Graham for Monday's game against the Commanders.
items.impact: Graham will add depth in the linebacker room for San Francisco.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Poona Ford (triceps) out for season
items.desc: Rams DT Poona Ford ruptured his triceps and is out for the season.
items.impact: It is another big blow for the Rams, especially on the defensive line.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kobie Turner (groin) to miss multiple weeks
items.desc: Rams head coach Sean McVay said Kobie Turner is out for "a handful for week" with a groin injury.
items.impact: The injuries continue to pile up for the Rams. It is unclear if Turner will be placed on injured reserve.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Myles Garrett (knee) will not practice this week
items.desc: Rams head coach Sean McVay said Myles Garrett will not return to practice this week.
items.impact: Garrett remains without a clear timetable to return. He remains week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Blake Grupe suffered torn ACL
items.desc: Rams head coach Sean McVay said Blake Grupe tore his ACL on Sunday.
items.impact: Grupe will officially miss the rest of the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Davante Adams to miss 6-10 weeks with ruptured hamstring
items.desc: Rams head coach Sean McVay told reporters that WR Davante Adams ruptured his hamstring and now will be sidelined 6-10 weeks.
items.impact: It is another brutal injury for the Rams and for fantasy managers. They'll likely continue to involve the tight ends even more in the passing game.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Lamar Jackson (ankle) could practice this week
items.desc: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said Lamark Jackson could "potentially" practice this week.
items.impact: Jackson missed a second straight game in Sunday's loss to the Browns. His status will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rashod Bateman (shoulder) hopeful to be fine
items.desc: Ravens coach Jesse Minter said there's optimism that Rashod Bateman will "be fine."
items.impact: Bateman remains off the fantasy radar when he is healthy.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tre'Davious White signs with Bills
items.desc: The Bills signed CB Tre'Davious White to their practice squad.
items.impact: White returns to his former team in a depth role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian Kirk (calf) will not play Monday
items.desc: Christian Kirk will not play in Monday's game against the Commanders.
items.impact: Kirk was listed as questionable entering Monday. He will hope to return in Week 7.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Romeo Doubs (shoulder) placed on IR
items.desc: The Patriots placed Romeo Doubs on injured reserve.
items.impact: Doubs left Sunday's game early in the third quarter. He will now miss at least the next four games.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) placed on IR
items.desc: The Commanders placed Jacory Croskey-Merritt on injured reserve.
items.impact: Croskey-Merritt will officially miss the next four weeks. Rachaad White and Austin Ekeler will lead the Commanders backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trey Amos (fibula) activated from IR
items.desc: The Commanders activated CB Trey Amos from injured reserve.
items.impact: Amos worked his way back from a broken fibula suffered last November. He should return to his starting role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Jacobs uncertain on availability for Week 7
items.desc: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said he is undecided on whether or not Josh Jacobs will play in Week 7 against the Lions.
items.impact: LaFleur said Jacobs will practice all week as he was removed from the commissioner exempt list.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jeremy McNichols (quad) activated from IR
items.desc: The Commanders activated Jeremy McNichols from injured reserve.
items.impact: McNichols will be good to go for Monday's game against the 49ers. He'll add depth in the Commanders backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jordan Mason (thumb) designated to return to practice
items.desc: The Vikings designed Jordan Mason to return from injured reserve.
items.impact: Mason will return to practice this week. He remains hopeful to return in Week 7 on Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tank Dell (knee) to play in Week 7
items.desc: Tank Dell (knee) will play in Week 7 for the Houston Texans according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Dell will take the field for the first time since December 2024 barring any setbacks in practice this week, as the talented wideout will look to boost a Houston passing attack against the New York Giants Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: C.J. Gardner-Johnson suspended one game
items.desc: C.J. Gardner-Johnson was suspended one game for spitting on Raiders tight end Brock Bowers Sunday according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Gardner-Johnson has battled a myriad of injuries while also displaying questionable character at times this season and will now leave the Buffalo secondary undermanned for their upcoming matchup against the Baltimore Ravens in Week 8 after the team's bye.

items.impact: Meiga will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Alec Pierce (heel) will not practice this week
items.desc: Colts coach Shane Steichen said Alec Pierce will not practice this week.
items.impact: Pierce remains without a clear timetable to return. He is week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Daniel Jones will start in Week 7
items.desc: Colts head coach Shane Steichen confirmed that Daniel Jones will start in Week 7 against the Vikings.
items.impact: Jones struggles continued in Sunday's loss against the Titans. He'll be a low-end QB2 play in Week 7 against the Vikings defense.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyle Dugger back in uniform at practice Monday
items.desc: Kyle Dugger was back in uniform for practice on Monday.
items.impact: Dugger will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dylan Sampson (knee) uncertain for Week 7
items.desc: Browns head coach Todd Monken said "it's too early to tell but I'm hopeful we'll get a number of (injured) guys back."
items.impact: Sampson was able to recently return to practice. He will need to be monitored in practice again throughout this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Quinshon Judkins (ankle) uncertain for Week 7
items.desc: Browns head coach Todd Monken said "it's too early to tell but I'm hopeful we'll get a number of (injured) guys back."
items.impact: Judkins will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week after missing Sunday's game against the Ravens.

items.title: Courtney Jackson works out for Colts
items.desc: The Colts worked out WR Courtney Jackson Courtney Jackson.
items.impact: Jackson was one of two wide receivers to workout for the Colts to begin the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ainias Smith works out for Colts
items.desc: The Colts worked out WR Ainias Smith.
items.impact: Smith was one of two wide receivers to workout for the Colts to begin the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cade Mays (wrist) on track to return in Week 7
items.desc: Cade Mays remains on track to return in Week 7 against the Packers.
items.impact: Mays has returned to practice and he is expected to be activated later this week. The same goes for safety Brian Branch. "Barring anything negatively happening between now and the game, we plan on playing both of those guys," Lions head coach Dan Campbell said.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brian Branch (Achilles) on track to return in Week 7
items.desc: Brian Branch remains on track to return in Week 7 against the Packers.
items.impact: Branch has returned to practice and he is expected to be activated later this week. The same goes for center Cade Mays. "Barring anything negatively happening between now and the game, we plan on playing both of those guys," Lions head coach Dan Campbell said.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josiah Deguara signs with Seahawks
items.desc: The Seahawks signed TE Josiah Deguara to their practice squad.
items.impact: Deguara will add depth in the Seahawks tight end room with Elijah Arroyo expected to miss time.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cooper Rush released by Falcons
items.desc: The Falcons released QB Cooper Rush.
items.impact: Rush struggled to begin the season as the Falcons starter. Atlanta signed Andy Dalton as the corresponding move.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Andy Dalton signs with Falcons
items.desc: The Falcons signed QB Andy Dalton.
items.impact: Dalton was recently released by the Eagles. He could compete with Tua Tagovailoa to backup Michael Penix Jr.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Elijah Arroyo (shoulder) to likely be placed on IR
items.desc: Elijah Arroyo is expected to be placed on injured reserve.
items.impact: Arroyo is expected to miss an extended period of time. He'll miss at least four weeks if/when he is placed on injured reserve.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Monroe Freeling (knee) could return in Week 7
items.desc: Monroe Freeling could return in Week 7 against the Buccaneers.
items.impact: "This is a first-round pick for us but we're gonna do what's best for the Panthers," Panthers coach Dave Canales said. Freeling will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jalon Daniels starter status up in the air Mayfield returning
items.desc: Jalon Daniels is starting off practice on Wednesday as the presumed starter, at least for initial game planning, for Week 7. Baker Mayfield is set to return to practice, and his performance will likely determine which of the two will end up being named the starter against Carolina.
items.impact: If Mayfield shows enough spark throughout the weeks and few ill effects from his injury, Mayfield will likely start unless the Bucs show an abundance of caution and start Daniels anyway. If Baker can't go, Daniels has shown decent enough ability when rushing to at least give him a floor, but lacks much of a ceiling due to little passing production in each of his three starts.
